corrected_text: In our build, the callback made by CreateInternalCallback, for each kProcessing Responses with text, appends Responses::GetTexts()[0] to a per-reply accumulated string and scans it from a cursor for channel and tool-call delimiters: text outside channels goes to the user callback as a Message built by model_data_processor.ToMessage from a copy of the released slice (SendMessage), channel text as {"role": "assistant", "channels": {name: text}} plus "reasoning_content": text for a reasoning channel such as thought (SendMessageToChannel), and a tool-call block is held until its end delimiter; on kDone, or on kMaxNumTokensReached when return_error_on_max_tokens_reached is false, SendCompleteMessage sends the unflushed text, builds the complete message from the whole accumulated text, calls complete_message_callback and then calls the user callback with an empty Message.
